title: BC Friday Tips #85 Schedule PTE Extension Updates from the Admin Centre
summary: You can schedule PTE extension updates from the Business Central Admin Centre during a configured update window instead of deploying manually outside business hours. This feature lets you plan deployments ahead and have Business Central apply them automatically at the scheduled time.
key_points: Set your environment's update window to occur outside working hours
Upload PTE extensions and schedule them for the next update window
Business Central automatically deploys extensions during the scheduled window
Eliminates manual deployments and after-hours work for extension updates

quotes.text: You can schedule PTE extension updates from the Business Central Admin Centre instead of deploying them manually outside business hours.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core capability that solves the problem of having to work outside normal hours for deployments.
